title: Lee and Macron Pledge Deeper Security Ties After Paris Summit
author: Mitch Shin
text:
South Korean President Lee Jae-myung and French President Emmanuel Macron wave before entering Élysée Palace for a summit, Paris, France, Sep. 8, 2026.
Credit: Facebook/ Lee Jae-myung
South Korean President Lee Jae-myung and French President Emmanuel Macron pledged on September 8 to deepen defense cooperation and coordinate on securing free passage through the Hormuz Strait. Their summit was the centerpiece event of Lee’s two-day state visit to France, which also produced new agreements on artificial intelligence, nuclear energy, and trade.Lee laid a wreath at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier beneath the Arc de Triomphe and took part in an official welcome ceremony before a one-on-one lunch with Macron at the Élysée Palace. An expanded summit followed, and the two leaders then addressed reporters together.[...]
